title.ko: 쇼핑 대화: 비교 · 최상급 · 반품과 환불
title.en: shopping: comparatives, superlatives, returns and refunds

explain.ko: 쇼핑에서는 비교급(cheaper than, more expensive than)과 최상급(the cheapest, the most popular)을 자주 씁니다. 짧은 형용사는 -er / -est, 긴 형용사는 more / the most를 붙입니다. 반품과 교환은 I'd like to exchange this / I'd like a refund로, 조건은 You need the receipt와 within 14 days 같은 기간 표현으로 말합니다. 가격 비교는 as ... as(This is as cheap as that one)도 유용합니다.
explain.en: In shopping language use comparatives (cheaper than, more expensive than) and superlatives (the cheapest, the most popular). Add -er / -est to short adjectives and more / the most to long ones. For returns say I'd like to exchange this / I'd like a refund; conditions are expressed with You need the receipt and time phrases like within 14 days. As ... as is also useful for price (This is as cheap as that one).

notes.ko: 비교급 뒤에는 than을 쓰고, 최상급 앞에는 the를 붙입니다.
notes.en: Use than after a comparative and the before a superlative.

notes.ko: 가격이 같으면 as cheap as, 더 저렴하면 cheaper than을 씁니다.
notes.en: Use as cheap as for equal price and cheaper than for lower price.
